---
title: "The project begins"
date: 2026-10-01
description: "With support from the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation, a two-year study of how errors shape AI-driven climate and Earth system modeling gets under way."
---

*The Productive Role of Error in AI-Driven Modeling* starts today, with support
from the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation. Over the next two years, philosopher Ryan
O'Loughlin (Queens College, CUNY) and Matthew Mayernik (NSF National Center for
Atmospheric Research) will study how scientists find, diagnose and learn from
errors in AI-driven models of the climate and Earth system.

The project will interview scientists at NSF NCAR, LEAP and NASA GISS and hold
an interdisciplinary workshop. A call for extended abstracts and speakers is
planned for February 2027.

[Read more about the project](../about.qmd) or [get involved](../contact.qmd).
